fixed.explanation: pathMatches appends a trailing slash to both paths, so a cookie path of /foo/ matches the URL path /foo. RFC 6265 path-match needs the request path to start with the cookie path, and either the cookie path ends in '/' or the next request-path character is '/'. I rewrote the function to follow that rule. domainMatches already handles host-only cookies correctly, so the other symptoms may come from a caller I haven't seen.

query.intent: Cookie URL matching logic in the browser context cookie store: filtering cookies by URL must check domain (host-only cookies must not match subdomains) and path with proper path-prefix semantics (cookie path /api must not match /apiv2; cookie path /foo/ should not match /foo per RFC 6265 path-match).
query.symptom: Cookies are matched to URLs incorrectly: host-only cookies are returned for subdomains, /api cookies for /apiv2, and /foo/ cookies for /foo.
